page.overview:
Who is Construction Patrol?

The Construction patrol were among the legions of Dead Universe Micromasters who pursued Hardhead and Nightbeat on Gorlam Prime. They survived to pursue the Autobots into the planet's subterranean caverns, and helped the Jhiaxus-possessed Nightbeat dig out after Hardhead triggered a cave-in. They then confronted Hardhead with Nightbeat and a small group of Micromasters, and were unable to stop Hardhead from killing Nightbeat and escaping into the Dead Universe.
